final: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) as count FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM race_counts), shares AS (SELECT name, count, CAST(count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_sum) as share FROM race_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_val FROM shares) SELECT name, count, share, (share - (SELECT avg_val FROM avg_share)) as diff FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_val FROM avg_share) ORDER BY name
